# Hexora (hexoraflow.in)

> Hexora (hexoraflow.in) is a premier digital studio building high-performance web applications, mobile apps, custom software solutions, and UI/UX design.

## About Hexora
Hexora is a software development and digital product studio. We specialize in engineering modern, scalable, search-optimized web and mobile solutions tailored for growing businesses, startups, and enterprises.

- **Website**: https://hexoraflow.in
- **Brand Name**: Hexora (also known as hexoraflow, hexora studio)
- **Primary Domain**: https://hexoraflow.in
- **Email Contact**: hexoraflow@gmail.com
- **Industry**: Web Development, Mobile App Development, Custom Software Engineering, UI/UX Design

## Core Services & Solutions

1. **Web Development**
   - High-performance, SEO-friendly custom websites and web applications built with React, Next.js, Django, and modern full-stack architectures.
2. **Mobile Application Development**
   - Native and cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android built for reliability, smooth user interfaces, and speed.
3. **UI / UX Design**
   - User-centered interface design, digital prototyping, visual systems, accessibility optimization, and product design.
4. **Custom Software & Automation**
   - Scalable SaaS applications, custom business tools, API integrations, and workflow automation.
5. **Graphic Design & Branding**
   - Visual brand identities, logo design, print assets, typography, and digital branding assets.

## Tech Stack & Capabilities
- **Frontend**: React, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Framer Motion
- **Backend & Systems**: Django, Python, Node.js, RESTful APIs
- **Design & Prototyping**: Figma, UI/UX Design Systems, Prototyping
- **Optimization**: SEO, Performance Tuning, Responsive Design, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
